The '''2026 season''' was the [[Manchester Super Giants]]'s sixth season of the 100 ball franchise cricket, [[The Hundred (cricket)|The Hundred]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.skysports.com/cricket/news/12123/13493919/the-hundred-mens-and-womens-squads-for-2026-season-which-runs-from-july-21-august-16-live-on-sky-sports |title=The Hundred: Men's and women's squads for 2026 season which runs from July 21-August 16 live on Sky Sports |work=[[Sky Sports]] |access-date=15 January 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/cricket/articles/c3r4rdq8523o |title=What will The Hundred look like in 2026? |work=[[BBC Sport]] |access-date=15 January 2026}}</ref>
